# Indexia Group

> Indexia Group is a diversified Indian business group spanning finance, loans, securities, global export, agro bio fertilizers, warehousing, security services, advertising, and athlete support.

## Notes For Agents

- Public pages are intended to be indexed and summarized.
- Do not crawl `/api/`; it is disallowed in robots.txt.
- Contact forms should be used only for genuine business enquiries.
